text: LDLC.com is the website of Groupe LDLC, a French société anonyme (RCS Lyon 403 554 181) whose shares are traded on Euronext Growth. At 31 March 2026 the only shareholders above 5% of the capital or the voting rights were members of the founding de la Clergerie family: Laurent Villemonte de la Clergerie with 17.80% of the capital (21.94% of the voting rights), Olivier with 10.35% (12.05%), Caroline with 9.46% (11.95%) and Suzanne with 0.15% (5.36%). Other shareholders held 61.14% of the capital and the company 1.10% of its own shares.
short: LDLC.com belongs to Groupe LDLC, listed on Euronext Growth; the founding de la Clergerie family holds about 38% of the capital and a majority of the votes.
